headline: 3 family members drown in Narayanganj DND lake
summary: The victims, including a 12-year-old girl, were bathing in the lake on Saturday afternoon when they suddenly drowned.
details: Three members of a family drowned while bathing in the DND lake in the Narayanganj district's Siddhirganj Upazila on Saturday.
The deceased have been identified as 22-year-old Md Rasheduzzaman, 18-year-old Md Galib, and 12-year-old Suraiya.
The victims were brother-in-law and sister-in-law to each other and lived in a rented house in Kashempara, Siddhirganj.
According to the police, the family had gone to the lake for bathing in the afternoon with several other members.
Despite the fact that all of them knew how to swim, the three suddenly drowned in the water.
Fire Service and Civil Defence divers recovered the bodies of Rasheduzzaman and Galib first, followed shortly by Suraiya's body.
Siddhirganj Police Inspector Mizanur Rahman stated that the lake is not suitable for bathing and similar drowning incidents have occurred there in the past.
The bodies were handed over to the families without postmortem examinations as there was no complaint from the relatives.

Despite the fact that all of them knew how to swim, the three suddenly drowned in the water.

headline_marked: Noakhali: [[Youth League leader expelled]] for publicly beating a woman
headline: Noakhali: Youth League leader expelled for publicly beating a woman
summary: The Jubbadal leader was removed from his position following a public assault on a woman, as announced by the party's Subarnachar upazila branch.
details: A Jubbadal leader in Noakhali has been expelled from the party for publicly beating a woman.
The expelled individual, Md. Safikul Islam, served as the general secretary of the 07th Ward Jubbadal under the 08th Mohammadpur Union.
The party's Subarnachar upazila branch stated that the expulsion was a result of social disorder and the violation of party discipline through the physical torture of a woman.
The decision was implemented by Belal Hossain Sumon, the convener of the Subarnachar upazila branch, and member secretary Nurul Huda.
The party has downgraded him to a primary member status before expelling him from the party entirely.
